main.description: Record that the authenticated user no longer wants the automatic Bluesky profile import offer. Idempotent: an existing dismissal is kept. Takes no input and returns an empty body.

errors.name: ServiceUnavailable
errors.description: The session store is temporarily unavailable; retry.

errors.name: AccountNotFound
errors.description: The authenticated user has no Coves account record.

errors.name: InvalidDID
errors.description: The authenticated user's DID is not valid.

errors.name: InternalServerError
errors.description: The dismissal could not be recorded.

errors.name: MethodNotAllowed
errors.description: The request method is not POST.
